premises.text: Restaurants have perishable table inventory and pay the same prices at peak and off-peak, leaving large underutilized capacity
premises.evidence_span: restaurants have perishable inventory. If a restaurant is not able to sell a table at 7 o'clock in the evening, it's a lost opportunity

premises.text: About 40% of restaurant inventory is underutilized from lack of revenue or yield management, contributing to high failure rates
premises.evidence_span: about 40% of the restaurant inventory is underutilized due to lack of revenue or yield management

premises.text: ResGuru is a dynamic pricing / GDS platform that automatically changes restaurant prices based on demand and supply
premises.evidence_span: ResGuru is a dynamic pricing platform for restaurants. It allows the restaurants to automatically change their prices based on demand and supply

premises.text: Consolidated reservation diary integrates POS and online/offline channels into one snapshot of performance including utilization and RevPASH
premises.evidence_span: a consolidated snapshot of my reservation diary, which is seamlessly integrated with my point of sale system

premises.text: Pricing engine uses many macro/micro variables and history to forecast demand and recommend prices per time slot under restaurant-set goals and rules
premises.evidence_span: taking into account 21 different variables, macro and micro data points, and along with historical trends to forecast the demand for me and give me a pricing strategy for each time slot during the day

value.text: Help restaurants optimize revenue and utilization through demand-based pricing
value.evidence_span: help them optimize their revenue, but also get you better deals in your restaurants

secondary_value.text: Reduce food waste by better forecasting and pricing
secondary_value.evidence_span: 130 million pounds of food is wasted on a daily basis
